questions.question: For the photorealistic cover, identify the verified creator and rights holder, a verifiable public source, and the legal basis for use. “Author’s illustration” and “Illustration accompanying the text” do not establish these facts.

localizations.source: For the photorealistic cover, identify the verified creator and rights holder, a verifiable public source, and the legal basis for use. “Author’s illustration” and “Illustration accompanying the text” do not establish these facts.
